title: CRM Custom Views — CVS-A03 / CVS-A04 rerun with a User-profile account — 2026-10-05

sessions.spec: Custom Views - Spec v3 Test Cases.xlsx (CVS-A03, CVS-A04)
sessions.label: a03-a04

testCases.name: CVS-A03 — The API refuses a public view from a user without Manage Shared Views

steps.desc: The API refuses a public view from a user without Manage Shared Views
steps.note: As test user 1 (User profile, no Manage Shared Views): POST /api/v1/modules/{Leads}/views {kind:list, name:QA CV api-public, visibility:everyone} -> 201; the same with a complete body -> 201. Both stored as public: listed in test user 1 GET and in the Owner GET; the Owner picker shows both under PUBLIC VIEWS. Expected 403/422 and nothing new under Public views. Both views deleted and purged by the Owner afterwards.

testCases.name: CVS-A04 — A user a view is shared with cannot edit or delete it in the UI or the API

steps.desc: A user a view is shared with cannot edit or delete it in the UI or the API
steps.note: Owner created QA CV shared (visibility selected, shared with test user 1 only). As test user 1: GET -> can_edit=true, can_delete=true; /views/{id}/edit opens with Save enabled and no You cannot edit this view message; PATCH {name:QA CV hijacked} -> 200 (renamed); DELETE -> 204; the Owner then gets 404. The deleted view is in neither the Owner nor the user Recycle Bin, so it cannot be restored.

defects.title: A User-profile user (no Manage Shared Views) can create public views through the API (POST 201, visible to everyone under Public views)
defects.scenario: CVS-A03 — The API refuses a public view from a user without Manage Shared Views
steps: Sign in as a User-profile user (no Manage Shared Views).
As the Owner, open the Leads view picker and look under Public views.
defects.expected: The POST is refused with 403 or 422; no "QA CV api-public" in either listing; nothing new under Public views.
defects.actual: As test user 1 (User profile, no Manage Shared Views): POST /api/v1/modules/{Leads}/views {kind:list, name:QA CV api-public, visibility:everyone} -> 201; the same with a complete body -> 201. Both stored as public: listed in test user 1 GET and in the Owner GET; the Owner picker shows both under PUBLIC VIEWS. Expected 403/422 and nothing new under Public views. Both views deleted and purged by the Owner afterwards.

defects.title: A user a view is shared with can edit and delete it (can_edit/can_delete true, PATCH 200, DELETE 204); the deleted view bypasses the Recycle Bin
defects.scenario: CVS-A04 — A user a view is shared with cannot edit or delete it in the UI or the API
steps: As the Owner, create a list view "QA CV shared" on Leads and share it with a User-profile user only.
As that user, GET /api/v1/modules/{Leads}/views/{id} and read can_edit / can_delete.
As that user, PATCH the view with {"name":"QA CV hijacked"}.
As that user, DELETE the view.
As the Owner, GET the view and check the Recycle Bin.
defects.expected: can_edit=false and can_delete=false; the editor shows "You cannot edit this view — Only its owner, or someone who can manage shared views, can change it."; PATCH and DELETE are refused; the view is unchanged for the Owner.
defects.actual: Owner created QA CV shared (visibility selected, shared with test user 1 only). As test user 1: GET -> can_edit=true, can_delete=true; /views/{id}/edit opens with Save enabled and no You cannot edit this view message; PATCH {name:QA CV hijacked} -> 200 (renamed); DELETE -> 204; the Owner then gets 404. The deleted view is in neither the Owner nor the user Recycle Bin, so it cannot be restored.
